svg.text: cross-contour lines: lines that travel over a form tell the eye it's round — before any shading does · seeded 6006
sphere — rings + meridians follow the surface
pear — rings widen with the belly
vase — ring spacing reads the lathe
What it taught: contours must bend with the surface and crowd where it turns away from the eye — draw straight lines across a form and you flatten it back into a picture.
